composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Illustrate Toshiro Hijikata in a plain dark casual jacket over a light shirt, with his familiar dark hair and adult facial structure. He holds an unmarked teacup low at chest height, with no other accessory. Keep the expression relaxed and approachable, softening the brows and adding only a slight smile. Use detailed animation rendering with controlled teal ambient light, careful hair strands, and understated fabric texture. His face turns shallowly toward the viewer so both eyes stay visible. A pale background band separates the hair from the darker field, while the cup and hand remain supporting details. Give both visible irises clear red patterns and bright catchlights. Behind the shoulders only, add two separate abstract black flame-shaped light ornaments for Amaterasu; they touch and burn nothing. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
